fields.label: Age (Days)
fields.description: Whole days since hatch. Filled automatically when you enter Age (Weeks).

fields.label: Age (Weeks)
fields.description: Optional. Enter weeks with up to two decimals (e.g. 2.5); converted to the nearest whole day.

fields.label: Average Weight (kg/animal)
fields.description: Optional non-negative number. Leave blank for unspecified; enter 0 for an explicit zero target.

fields.label: Daily Feed Intake (g/animal/day)
fields.description: Optional non-negative number. Leave blank for unspecified; enter 0 for an explicit zero target.

fields.label: Interval FCR (kg/kg)
fields.description: Optional non-negative number. Leave blank for unspecified; enter 0 for an explicit zero target.

fields.label: Hen-Day Egg Yield (%)
fields.description: Optional non-negative number. Leave blank for unspecified; enter 0 for an explicit zero target.

fields.label: Daily Mortality (%)
fields.description: Optional. Chance (0-100) that an animal alive at this age dies on this day. Leave blank for unspecified; use Fill Mortality from Cumulative to convert breed-guide cumulative figures.
